title: Score-SDE
paper_title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
core_mech: 以连续 score field 同时定义 reverse-time SDE、predictor-corrector sampler 与同边缘的 probability-flow ODE。
core_mech_en: Unifies discrete diffusion and score matching into a continuous-time Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) with a corresponding deterministic Probability-Flow ODE.
input_desc: 数据样本 x(0)；生成时的先验噪声 x(T)
input_en: Continuous data sample x(0); prior noise distribution x(T) at terminal time T
output_desc: 经 reverse SDE 或 probability-flow ODE 得到的样本
output_en: Samples generated via Predictor-Corrector reverse SDE or exact likelihoods via Probability-Flow ODE

adapter.name: Score-SDE
adapter.mechanism: Continuous VP marginal noising and denoising score matching; reverse SDE and probability-flow ODE have different score coefficients.
limitations: VP branch and Euler integration only; original predictor-corrector networks and published settings are not recreated.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.

verification.title: Score-SDE
verification.budget_enforcement: cooperative boundary checks; not an OS allocation limit
limitations: VP branch and Euler integration only; original predictor-corrector networks and published settings are not recreated.

verification.isolation: One fresh Python process per model; sequential execution
verification.evidence_note: Original successful execution retained at its original version and date. Executable code and this dataset match the captured release; source registry metadata changed. No model was rerun by this build.

gaps: Original method has no implemented and tested local CPU adapter.
